Among the Best Senior Schools in London
Wetherby Senior School
Join our Open Day on 03 October 2026
A World-Class Senior School in Marylebone
Welcome to Wetherby Senior, a prestigious independent senior school for boys in Marylebone, where we cultivate young minds to become extraordinary individuals. We offer a world-class education rooted in the rich legacy of the Wetherby school group.
At Wetherby Senior, we believe in more than just teaching, we inspire. Our academic excellence, outstanding preparation and tailored university support empower boys to reach their full potential, nurturing their unique talents and preparing them for a future filled with limitless possibilities. With a rigorous curriculum and a commitment to personalised learning, we guide our students toward success at top universities and beyond.
At Wetherby Senior, we foster a growth mindset, encouraging our boys to embrace challenges, think critically, and innovate. We instill in them a strong sense of purpose and the confidence to pursue their passions, ensuring they are well-prepared to achieve unlimited success in an ever-evolving world
Why Choose Our Senior School in Marylebone, London?
Wetherby Senior’s top status is due to our excellent record of academic achievement and distinguished connections with the eminent Wetherby school group. At our senior school in Marylebone, we provide boys with a world-class private education in a stimulating setting, inspire them to aim high and promote practical skills that allow them to pursue their aspirations.
World-Class Academic Provision
Our ambitious curriculum, leading tutelage and outstanding results build on the legacy of the world-renowned Wetherby school group.
Unparalleled University Guidance
A bespoke, expert-led programme of events, lectures and tailored support leads to admission into Russell Group and Ivy League universities.
Maximising Boys’ Potential with Prestigious Partnerships
Wetherby partners with industry experts to develop boys’ talents across disciplines, ensuring a lifetime of success and achievement.
Nurturing the Leaders of Tomorrow
Strong values are embedded throughout school life to foster resilience, a growth mindset and a spirit of entrepreneurialism.
A Path to Achievement for All Students
We have established elite partnerships to elevate boys’ talents in exciting disciplines. Professional musicians from Europe’s top bands and orchestras provide leading tutelage in a wide variety of musical instruments. Our exemplary sports programme features guest coaching from Eddie Jones, the former England national rugby coach, and Saracens Rugby Club, among others. Through our comprehensive and esteemed careers programme, learners gain up-to-date knowledge and meet industry experts from across all fields.
The outstanding achievements of our boys and Wetherby alumni bolster our claim to being one of the best senior schools in London: not only do learners achieve top outcomes in their GCSEs and A Levels, but Wetherby graduates enjoy flourishing careers in some of the most exciting industries, from Olympic rower Constantine Louloudis MBE to musical-theatre giant Andrew Lloyd Webber.
Lower School
Middle School
Sixth Form
Recognition & Accreditations
Wetherby Senior School is a finalist for Boys Independent School of the Year. Furthermore, our accredited programmes reflect excellence in teaching, pastoral care, and student development, giving families confidence in every aspect of their boys’ education.
Muddy's Best Schools Award - Highly Commended, Outstanding Pastoral Care
Read the Talk Education review
Independent Boys’ School of the Year - Finalist
ALPS Diamond Award - GCSE
Leading Independent Schools
One of the best senior schools in London, Wetherby Senior is a proud member of Inspired Education, the leading global group of 121 top independent schools. Inspired champions a holistic approach that combines excellence in academics, sports and the arts, nurturing valuable tools and skills for future success. Students are challenged and stimulated as they navigate respected curricula, led by talented teachers with outstanding credentials, access premium resources and foster their talents with a wide selection of enriching co-curricular activities.
Learn More About Inspired
World-class teaching is the key to Inspired’s record of academic excellence and accomplishment. At our senior school in Marylebone, subject specialists leverage top credentials to deliver a wide variety of engaging lessons across disciplines, blending innovative methods with global best practices.
Expansive International Opportunities
Expansive International Opportunities
Collaborating with peers in other countries is an excellent way to develop important life skills while studying at one of the UK’s top boys’ schools. Through Inspired’s themed Summer Camps and Global Exchange Programme, students take part in prestigious opportunities that cultivate their talents in elite sports, arts and other areas, as well as forge lasting connections with learners at other Inspired schools.
International Group of Premium Schools
International Group of Premium Schools
With over 110 schools across 6 continents, Inspired sets the standard for high-quality independent education. Inspired schools share a commitment to excellence that goes far beyond traditional academics, offer world-class resources and the best tuition, and build various elite partnerships to maximise each child’s potential from age 1 to 18.
Entry to Boarding Schools Worldwide
Entry to Boarding Schools Worldwide
As Inspired students, our boys automatically gain entry into the Group’s prestigious boarding schools, including those in other countries. No matter where they choose to study, pupils enjoy the same high standard of academic and co-curricular provision as that provided by Wetherby Senior School. Inspired’s welcoming boarding schools are the ideal setting to extend boys’ learning and develop invaluable qualities for life, such as independence, strong self-esteem and adaptability.
Discover more about our prestigious senior school for boys in Marylebone and how outstanding tuition, extensive co-curricular activities and tailored support for university provide the best pathway to success in school and later life.

About Us
The Perfect Environment for Maximising Our Boys' Potential
A Word From Our Head
In our relatively short history, Wetherby Senior has built a vibrant, diverse and caring community with strong shared values. Our objective is simple – we want our young people to experience an outstanding, well-rounded and progressive education that prepares them to face modern life with a strong sense of responsibility and compassion towards others.
Our dynamic, experienced teachers provide an environment which inspires and nurtures our boys as individuals. The breadth of our academic offering is designed to help students become young adults who are resilient, adaptable, creative, and motivated to continue learning throughout their lives.
Our extensive co-curricular programme helps boys to develop their unique passions and pursue new interests. We offer a diverse range of clubs, music tuition in various instruments, and at least three drama productions every year. Sport is compulsory, and boys enjoy access to superb on-site equipment and state-of-the-art external facilities.
Exceptional university and career guidance begins early at Wetherby Senior, and our recent alumni now study at leading universities across the UK, Europe and North America.
Our website provides some insight into life at Wetherby Senior, but I warmly invite you to attend our Open Day or Visitor Mornings, where you will get to meet me, my colleagues and our pupils, and experience our school firsthand.
Robert Garvey, Headmaster
A Path Towards Success
Our Vision
Our vision at Wetherby Senior School is to provide an outstanding holistic education, nurturing students who excel academically and develop as people while preparing them to meet the challenges of twenty-first-century life and contribute confidently to the wider world.
Our Values
The focus of our values is on character, community and respect. We believe in the importance of striving for personal development, taking one’s part in and serving the wider community, and having respect for and understanding one another.
Our Aims
The academic life of our school is central to what we do. Rigorous learning and high-quality teaching enable academic success and unlock the potential of every learner. We aim to cultivate and embed a love of learning that enables our learners to adapt throughout their lives. We also foster engagement and resilience through the understanding that effort leads to progress, confidence and success.
Excellent pastoral care underpins individual success. We provide an environment in which all community members feel secure and supported, allowing them to thrive as individuals.
The co-curricular life of our school is enriching for each pupil, develops their character, and enables them to find and nurture their talents and interests. We offer a high-quality programme of creative arts, sports and co-curricular activities that give opportunities for leadership, service, teamwork, global engagement and personal growth.
We have first-class staff, resources, and facilities to support our aims, and an admissions process that attracts talented pupils who will thrive in our community.
An Ambitious Curriculum
Our rigorous curriculum is taught by subject specialists and elevated by outstanding facilities to reinforce knowledge and maximise understanding.
Our fascinating and rewarding Lower School curriculum provides a solid foundation for future studies. All Year 7s learn to play a brass or string instrument, with teaching supported by professional musicians.
The dynamic Middle School curriculum features a structured programme that supports leading preparation and decision-making for GCSEs and reflects each boy’s unique ambitions.
In the Sixth Form, classes remain small, and boys select three A Levels and complete their Extended Project Qualification (EPQ) on a topic of their choosing.
Discover the benefits of our ambitious approach and how our learners are continuously nurtured, supported and challenged to unlock their full potential.

Careers
Join a school celebrating a decade of shaping exceptional young minds with a commitment to academic excellence and personal growth. At Wetherby Senior School, you will be part of a dynamic, collaborative team dedicated to inspiring excellence, where innovation, creativity, and professional development are at the core of everything we do. Work in the heart of Marylebone, London, a vibrant area offering access to world-class cultural, academic, and professional opportunities.
Learn More about Wetherby Senior School
Part of Inspired Education
At Inspired Education, we offer an exceptional opportunity to join the world’s leading premium school group and shape the future of education.
Purpose & Growth Journey Join a global community with an unwavering commitment tot empowers over 90,000 students across 26 countries. As the fastest-growing education group, your contributions will directly impact our journey of continuous global expansion and excellence.
Career Development We believe in nurturing talent and offering endless possibilities for career advancement. With Inspired, you will have access to opportunities across our 118 schools, enabling you to pursue your ambitions on a global scale. 31% of our educators take on exciting new roles overseas, and over 26% of our head appointments are made from within.
Global Community & Collaboration You will become part of a diverse, inclusive team of more than 12,000 professionals from over 109 nationalities. Together, we cultivate a culture of respect, dignity, and inclusion, where your talents and experiences are valued and celebrated.
Leaders in EdTech & Innovation We are transforming education through advanced technology and cutting-edge innovation. We invest more than any other school group in AI, EdTech, and immersive learning, enabling our educators to personalise learning paths and improve student outcomes.
State-of-the-Art Facilities Our campuses are designed to reflect our progressive approach to education. You will work in an environment that encourages exploration, creativity, and student engagement. With access to the latest tools and technologies, you will have the resources to inspire and motivate students, helping them to thrive in a rapidly evolving world.
A Culture of Innovation & Growth We foster a growth mindset that extends beyond our students to our entire community. Together, we are shaping a future where education is dynamic, inclusive, and always evolving.
Learn More about Inspired Careers

Academic Results
At Wetherby Senior, boys are encouraged – academically and socially – to realise their full potential, which is reflected in the outstanding exam results achieved in Years 11 and 13.
A Level Results 2026
A Level Results Day 2026 saw strong results for Wetherby Senior’s outgoing Year 13, including:
These results are well above the national trend which shows 29% of grades awarded at A* or A, and 56% of pupils achieving A* to B.
GCSE Results Day 2026 saw Wetherby Senior’s Year 11 achieve excellent GCSE results, including a string of top grades:
GCSE grades nationally at grade 9-7 were 22% which we beat by almost 3 times at Wetherby Senior School. In addition, 21% of Wetherby Senior’s Year 11 achieved 9 or more grades 9-7 (A**-A) in all their GCSE subjects.
Niam Shah achieved exceptional A* grades in English Literature, Economics, and Business Studies, which has earned him a place at the prestigious University of Warwick to pursue a BSc in Finance and Management. During his seven years at Wetherby Senior School, he excelled academically while representing the 1st XI football team and participating in tennis and athletics, reflecting the school's commitment to a well-rounded education. Niam also served as a prefect, peer mentor, and academic mentor; experiences that have shaped his personal growth and will undoubtedly contribute to his future success. He expresses deep gratitude for Wetherby's transformative role in preparing him for the future academic, personal, and professional challenges that lie ahead.
James Siskind has achieved exceptional A-level results at Wetherby Senior School, attaining A* grades in History and his Extended Project Qualification, alongside A grades in Geography and Government and Politics. His outstanding achievements have earned him a place at the prestigious Princeton University for the upcoming academic year, James' success Story exemplifies the transformative power of an Inspired Education, empowering students to reach their full potential and pursue their dreams.
Oliver Bush achieved exceptional A-level results with grades in Maths, Further Maths, Physics, Italian, and EPO — demonstrating Wetherby Senior School's ability to nurture individual academic passions. Beyond academics, his remarkable endurance in the school Charity cycling competition highlights the holistic development fostered at Wetherby. As he begins his studies in Mechanical Engineering at Imperial College, Oliver reflects: "Wetherby and A-levels have shown me that with hard work, the right structure, and a constructive mindset, dreams do come true." His success exemplifies the limitless potential unlocked through an Inspired Education.
Oscar Frederiksen achieved exceptional A-level results with grades in Politics, Geography, and EPQ, plus an A in Mathematics — earning him a place at the prestigious Edinburgh University to study Politics. As Head Boy at Wetherby Senior School, he demonstrated outstanding leadership by organising the school's inaugural international Model United Nations conference hosting 150 students. Reflecting on his journey, Oscar shares: "A-levels taught me the importance Of consistency, perseverance, and genuine hard work — as well as the value of seizing every opportunity presented."
At Wetherby Senior, learners are empowered to dream big and, more importantly, work hard to make their dreams a reality. Discover a world of unlimited opportunities, where your child can reach his full potential.

Scholarships & Bursaries
Transforming Lives with an Exceptional Education
Studying at Wetherby Senior is a transformative experience, and we are immensely proud of the opportunities that we offer. Bursaries and scholarships are essential to this legacy, as they allow us to welcome boys of different economic backgrounds. This has the dual impact of making a life-changing difference for the individual pupil and broadening the experience and perspectives of all our young people.
Nsouli Scholars
A Transformative Opportunity
The Nsouli Scholars Programme is an exciting global initiative that promises to transform lives by enabling 50 extraordinary students at any one time to attend any of Inspired’s prestigious schools on a full scholarship for the duration of their education. The ambition is that the scholarship will provide hundreds of children with an opportunity to receive a truly transformative education.
By opening this path to exceptional individuals, we hope to expand our community, and to empower children of all backgrounds with unrivalled opportunities in academics, sports, the arts and extracurricular activities. In this sense, the Nsouli Scholars Programme is an investment both in education and in shaping the leaders of tomorrow.
This generous endowment honours Nadim Nsouli, who founded Inspired in 2013 as a definitive statement of excellence in private international education. In recognition of Mr Nsouli’s Lebanese heritage and Inspired’s commitment to inclusivity, several scholarships will be awarded to individuals of Lebanese origin.
Inspired schools offer a world-class educational experience that combines academics and engaging extra-curricular activities, producing confident, multi-skilled students who flourish in a competitive and increasingly interconnected world. Along with expert instruction by hand-picked teachers, our students access specialist sports programmes and professional tutelage from leaders in the performing and creative arts. As a result, they leave armed with a robust value system and a love of learning that extends well beyond the classroom.
Inspired is also committed to leveraging new and transformative learning technologies. Inspired AI empowers children to achieve academic excellence by delivering actionable insights that are unique to each student, including strengths and weaknesses. Our partnership with The Royal College of Music and Forte, a revolutionary online platform, enables children to receive personalised music tuition from professionals. Students with musical interests benefit from bespoke private lessons, advancing their practice as creatives and gaining valuable performance experience.
The advantages of our holistic approach to education are evidenced by the fact that Inspired students consistently excel in academic performance, surpassing national and global averages. In 2022, the Average Point Score was 35 for those undertaking the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma, for which the world average was 31.98, while A* scores comprised 27% of our students' A Level grades, compared to 14.6% globally. As a consequence, many are able to attend leading universities, with one in three graduates going on to a Russell Group University or Ivy League College.
The Inspired Group includes top-rated day and boarding schools worldwide, meaning students enjoy access to a diverse international community. Be it through specialised Summer Camps or immersive Global Exchange Programmes, children have the chance to travel broadly and engage meaningfully with different cultures, meet and learn from our esteemed partners, build lifelong networks, and become more independent.
Means-Tested Bursaries
Wetherby Senior offers financial assistance in the form of bursaries, which are designed to widen access to our school by (1) enabling boys to come who could not otherwise do so, and (2) allowing boys to remain at our school in the event of a change in family circumstances.
Applicants for 11+, 16+ or Occasional Place entry should indicate their intention to request a bursary when they submit their application. Our bursary application process runs alongside the admissions process for applicants at these entry points.
Applicants for 13+ entry should apply after securing a place at Wetherby Senior. Applications must be submitted by the start of the Spring Term prior to a boy joining in Year 9.
How to Apply for a Bursary
Should you wish to apply for a bursary, please click the button below. Bursaries are subject to a detailed means test by the Gold Standard Charitable Trust (GSCT), which administers bursaries at all Inspired UK schools.
Sixth Form Academic Scholarships
Any current Year 11 pupil or prospective Year 12 pupil may apply for a Wetherby Senior Sixth Form Scholarship. These are of monetary value and are expressed as a percentage discount on school fees for the whole of the Sixth Form period. Being awarded one of our Sixth Form Academic Scholarships is a prestigious accomplishment. Scholarship holders will be recognised at Prize Day in our Summer Term and are expected to contribute to the Wetherby school community while excelling in their studies.
Prospective pupils write scholarship exams (separate from the 16+ admissions exams) during the second half of the Autumn Term in conjunction with the admissions process. The content of each paper will be GCSE-level material on subjects the boy wishes to study at A Level.
Our Scholarship Committee will meet to consider the results of the papers along with the relevant considerations, such as the candidates’ existing academic data.
Discover more about our transformative bursary and scholarship offering, which allows deserving candidates to access an exceptional education.

University and Career Guidance
Outstanding Preparation for Success Beyond School
We proudly provide students with a path to success that includes unparalleled university guidance and career development. Through tailored support and outstanding preparation, our learners gain valuable tools and knowledge that allow them to make informed decisions about their futures and empower them to reach their highest ambitions.
The results speak for themselves: our graduates secure coveted places at some of the most prestigious universities in the UK, Europe and North America, and possess all the necessary skills and qualities to flourish in the 21st century.
A Tailored Pathway to the Best Universities
Personal University Advisor
We provide boys with exceptional, personalised university guidance to help them attend the universities of their dreams. In Year 11, each boy is assigned a personal university advisor to guide and empower their higher education planning. Our excellent university advisors are passionate, dedicated and highly qualified, with over 100 years of combined support experience, meaning boys receive all the best knowledge and support during their applications.
Specialised Guidance for North American Universities
As well as supporting plans to study in the UK and continental Europe, we have two exceptional advisors to assist with applications to North American universities. Our US advisors provide one-to-one guidance on the North American application process, plus weekly group sessions on preparing application essays. Their expertise is reflected in our Sixth Form’s fantastic results: in just three years, our sixth formers have received forty offers to study in the US and Canada.
Talks, Workshops and Events
Our sixth formers benefit from a prestigious programme designed to complement their tailored university guidance. From workshops on US applications and talks by university representatives to twilight seminars for parents on possible destinations, we provide ample opportunities to inspire and educate learners as they prepare for the next phase of their education.
Wetherby Senior’s annual university fair, co-hosted with Francis Holland School, provides a valuable opportunity to talk with over 20 representatives from institutions across the UK and beyond, learning more about higher education options. We also take our learners to visit different universities and see what student life is like, learn about degrees from university staff, and speak to current undergraduates.
A Comprehensive Careers Programme
Wetherby Senior seeks to empower learners to fulfil their potential in an ever-changing, increasingly competitive world. This goal is reflected in our excellent careers programme, which begins the moment boys join and aims to inspire, motivate and incentivise every pupil.
Through our comprehensive approach – including mock interviews, skills-based projects, expert talks, internal discussions, personal development, subject linkage, and co-curricular activities – we equip our pupils with the necessary skills and knowledge to make informed career choices. We explore university options and professional life with support from a brilliant range of potential employers, our own fantastic staff and our wonderful alumni network.
Discover more about our unparalleled university support and how students are challenged, guided and supported to ensure their success beyond senior school.

Enquire Now
Begin Your Inspiring Journey Today!
Wetherby Senior School provides boys with a path to unlimited opportunities. Our holistic and ambitious curriculum, world-class teachers and leading results build on the legacy of the highly regarded Wetherby school group. Learners enjoy excellent guidance from a team of experienced university advisors and go on to attend many prestigious universities in the UK, Europe and North America. Unrivalled enrichment and elite partnerships offer exceptional opportunities to nurture boys’ talents, along with the qualities needed to achieve their greatest ambitions.
If you have a question about our excellent school, kindly get in touch by completing an Enquiry Form.

An Inspired School
Embracing Individuality, Preparing Leaders
Our school is part of Inspired Education, the leading group of 125 premium schools, offering world-class private education in over 28 countries. A definitive statement of excellence in independent education, Inspired schools are exceptionally resourced to promote top outcomes in academics, sports, the arts and other areas. By providing prestigious and unique experiences, Inspired nurtures the potential of each student and empowers them to become curious, confident, multi-skilled learners with unlimited opportunities for future success. Inspired's headquarters are located at: 6th Floor, 3 Burlington Gardens, London W1S 3EP. Telephone: 020 3867 9960
Learn More About Inspired
The Three Pillars of Inspired Education
Inspired’s holistic approach is designed to extend the potential of each learner, delivering excellent results both in class and beyond. At Inspired schools, pupils are challenged to explore new and existing interests, develop strong personal qualities and cultivate a diverse skill set by leveraging outstanding tuition and access to the best resources. An Inspired education goes well beyond traditional academics: at all stages of a child’s development, we endeavour to integrate the Three Pillars of an Inspired Education – Academics, Sport, and Performing and Creative Arts – and create the ideal springboard for a lifetime of accomplishment.
High-quality academic provision is the cornerstone of an Inspired education. Inspired teachers bring leading credentials and the most up-to-date knowledge to provide a challenging, stimulating learning experience across all disciplines, blending innovative methods with global best practices to deliver a range of world-renowned syllabi, elevated by outstanding facilities. Many students achieve top results and, upon graduating, one in three attends Russell Group and Ivy League universities.
There are numerous benefits to maintaining a physical routine; for this reason, Sport is integral to Inspired’s educational offering. Inspired sports programmes help budding athletes develop their talents in a range of elite team and solo sports. Talented and professional coaches provide leading tutelage and guide learners to exceptional outcomes, including excellence at the highest levels, while also fostering a love of sport. In addition to nurturing their technical abilities, Inspired’s excellent sports provision allows learners to maintain their physical, social and emotional wellbeing while garnering new qualities and competencies, such as teamwork, discipline and leadership skills.
Performing and Creative Arts
Performing and Creative Arts
At Inspired schools, students are taught to adopt a creative approach to life, nurturing valuable and highly transferable skills through exemplary arts programmes. Students with a flair for performing access top tuition from professionals with outstanding credentials, cultivate new and existing interests and become highly accomplished in music, drama, dance and many other areas. Nurturing their artistic abilities allows students to not only foster their unique characters but also gain confidence, discipline and problem-solving skills.
Inspired Schools Around the World
Discover more about Inspired Education and how being part of a globally renowned school group can lead to unlimited opportunities for our students.

University Destinations
A Pathway to Success at the World's Best Universities
Outstanding academic provision and tailored support provide boys with a path to prestigious universities. From the day they enrol, we empower them to set high standards and achieve exceptional outcomes. Our talented team of university counsellors bring over 100 years of collective experience, so they are more than equipped to facilitate boys’ ambitions.
We are incredibly proud of our Wetherby Senior alumni, who secure places at leading universities across London, the UK and the world. Please see below for a list of our university destinations.

Student Testimonials
“I had a fantastic time at Wetherby Senior and was given so many opportunities – from being Head Boy to taking part in sport. One of my favourite memories will always be performing in our school plays. In Year 9, I took part in Trib Drama, never thinking I’d love this so much that I’d star in future productions and, eventually, take a lead role in my final year.”
Matteo completed his A Levels in 2023. He is now reading materials science and engineering at the University of Pennsylvania, a prestigious Ivy League college in the US.
“I am incredibly proud of how far I came at Wetherby Senior – I was a Deputy Head Boy, a regular performer in plays, represented our School in sports, and led the pupil body in voluntary work, before being accepted to study at one of the world’s most competitive universities.”
Benjamin completed his A Levels in 2023. He is now reading education at the world-leading University of Cambridge.
For further information about our university destinations, please click the button below and submit an Enquiry Form. A member of our team will get back to you shortly.

Open Day
Join our Open Day on 03 October 2026
What to Expect During our Open Day
We look forward to welcoming you to meet staff, boys and current parents at our Open Day. Mr Robert Garvey, the Headmaster, will talk about the School and his strategic vision for its future, alongside the Head Boy and one of our Lower School form captains, who will give their personal perspectives on what makes the School a great place to learn and grow.
Families will receive one-to-one tours of the School, led by our pupil guides. It is a great opportunity for you to see the fantastic facilities on our campus but also to interact with staff and pupils on all facets of school life from academic subjects to co-curricular, sport, creative and performing arts.
At the end of the tour there is an opportunity to meet informally with senior staff and members of the PTA to ask about any aspect of life at Wetherby, including the admissions process, over refreshments.
If there are no Open Day places available on the form below or none that fit your schedule, we welcome you to visit the school at your convenience by scheduling a Personalised Tour today!

pageCache.pageTitle: ᐅ A levels in London, Marylebone ᐅ Wetherby Senior, London
pageCache.text:
A Levels
A Levels in Marylebone, London
Year 12 students choose between 3 and 4 specialist subjects from a list of Advanced Level courses (A Levels) that are specifically designed to enrich students’ knowledge, promote critical thinking and inspire academic excellence.
Completed over two intensive years, Years 12 and 13, A Levels are a widely respected post-16 qualification and are recognised by the most prestigious universities in the world.
Expert-led academic provision, tailored support and outstanding preparation mean that our students are consistently rewarded with top outcomes in their A Level exams, and most are accepted into Russell Group universities.
Our students supplement their A Level courses with a broad and highly engaging co-curricular programme that nurtures the most in-demand skills and resources for success in the 21st century.
Benefits of Taking A Levels at Our School
We prepare boys in our sixth form to achieve their greatest ambitions. Talented teachers with the best credentials lead a tailored, aspirational A Level programme, carefully crafted to promote excellence, deepen engagement, and instil a love of learning. Each learner has a personal university advisor who nurtures his higher-education goals, and our structured programme of events, talks and workshops allows boys to meet and learn from industry experts.
We encourage boys to pursue their interests and develop outstanding abilities in sports, the arts, and other disciplines with our broad array of co-curricular activities. Our learners cultivate the most valuable skills for achieving their dreams beyond senior school and emerge confident, resilient, independent and with a spirit of entrepreneurialism.
Year 12 and 13 boys access our spacious sixth-form study rooms and a comfortable common room, which offer the ideal setting for unlocking their potential.
Why Choose Our School to Study A Levels in London?
We foster an academically rigorous and nurturing environment for A Levels, the results of which speak for themselves. Experienced, talented teachers lead a bespoke curriculum that challenges and stimulates our boys in all disciplines. Extension projects deepen their knowledge and develop their critical thinking skills, and allow them to discover new interests and bolster their applications for university.
Students’ higher-education goals are encouraged and supported through the assignment of a personal university advisor. With over 100 years of collective experience, our talented advisors craft tailored pathways to some of the world's most esteemed universities, including Russell Group and Ivy League schools.
While pursuing their chosen A Levels, learners hone their talents in a wide variety of enriching co-curricular activities, gaining valuable skills and personal qualities that pave the way to future accomplishment.
A Pathway to Unlimited Opportunities
Bespoke university counselling, expert-led career development and elite partnerships prepare boys to join top universities and excel in any industry.
Prestigious, Wide-Ranging Co-Curricular Activities
World-renowned experts and professionals offer leading tuition in exciting disciplines to promote valuable skills and qualities for life.
An Extensive A Level Offering
Our broad selection of A Level subjects, led by talented specialists, cater to every interest, strength and ambition.
A Level Choices
A Level Art and Design is the course for you if you have an imagination and a dedicated work ethic, and if you want to explore a range of disciplines and give visual form to your thoughts, feelings, observations and ideas.
Are you captivated by the animals on BBC nature programmes? Do you want to understand the causes of cancer or the potential uses of stem cells in medicine? Are you concerned about the impacts of our ever increasing population on the environment? If so, A Level Biology is for you. Biologists want to understand how living organisms function and interact, so they can help solve problems of the future.
Business is a field that is undeniably important to society, with businesses and business leaders having been the key architects of the digital age and the globalised world we inhabit.
Chemistry is sometimes known as the central science, as it connects physical sciences (e.g., mathematics, physics) with applied sciences (e.g., biology, medicine, engineering). A Level Chemistry provides an opportunity to study the amazing variety of substances that make up our world, as you appreciate why they are the way they are, why they behave as they do, and how they can be adapted and used in modern life.
A Level Drama is a vastly enjoyable course that focuses on creativity, academic reading, teamwork and performing, as you write your own plays, act in plays, and review professional productions. Top universities appreciate that A Level Drama applicants have strong skills in literature, leadership and public speaking, yet it is also an excellent option if you wish to take a balanced array of subjects. It also looks good on university applications when taken alongside subjects that require different skills, since it proves your well-roundedness as a scholar.
What caused the global economy to crash in 2008? How will the rise of AI affect your future? How bad for the UK is 9% inflation? Why has the cost of living increased so much? Is the NHS the best way to provide healthcare for the UK? Is inequality growing and should we care? By studying A Level Economics, you will gain the tools to tackle these questions, as well as examine the questions that will define our current and future generations.
One of the best ways to develop a greater understanding of both yourself and others is through the careful study of literature, which can act as a gateway into the broadest possible range of lives, places and experiences. By reading and studying works of literature, you are able to explore bold ideas, travel in strange and fascinating worlds, and experience more than you could ever hope to in just one lifetime. While, hopefully, all of that sounds challenging and rewarding, perhaps the best reason to study A Level English Literature is that reading, discussing and writing about literature can simply be really good fun!
More than 220 million people speak French on five continents and France is a key economic global player, with French being the other language of international relations widely used, alongside English, in the UN, the EU, UNESCO and NATO.
A Level Further Mathematics is aimed at those who enjoy mathematics, as it provides a challenge and a chance to explore new and/or more sophisticated mathematical concepts. As well as being highly regarded by universities, those who take A Level Further Mathematics often find that the additional time spent studying mathematics boosts their marks in A Level Mathematics.
Geographers are excited about the world in which they live and develop a valuable understanding of the physical and human processes which shape our planet. If you want to answer questions such as, ‘What are the issues caused by unequal flows of international trades?’, ‘How will the world cope with a projected population of 10 billion?’, or ‘How would a supervolcano eruption affect our planet?’ then A Level Geography is the subject for you.
Globally, around 132 million people speak German as a first or second language and learning German will open the door to exciting opportunities in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the UK, as Germany is one of Britain’s biggest trade partners with strong financial service and business ties.
Government and Politics
If you want to know where power lies, how parties operate, and how governments work, then A Level Government and Politics is for you. Politics has an enormous impact on our lives, and A Level Government and Politics will equip you with a strong understanding of how power is exercised, in this country and internationally. It will equip you with the knowledge and skills to play a full part in the political process.
History is the study of humanity in all of its chaotic complexity. While there is a real pleasure to be derived from delving into the narrative of our past for its own sake, history is not just about chronicling the past. It is an ongoing dialogue, between academics, who use empirical evidence to explain why events unfolded as they did. The breadth of evidence available makes history a truly multidisciplinary subject. When historians investigate the past, they have to use an array of relevant skills in order to come to the fullest understanding possible of the period.
A Level Latin offers an insight into one of the greatest ancient civilisations of the western world. Not only will you continue to develop your linguistic skills, you will use these skills to read and analyse some of the finest pieces of literature written. Such texts are wonderful to read in themselves but it is very gratifying to read them in the original language, knowing over 2,000 years separates you from the author.
Our sixth form’s Liberal Studies options are designed to help you extend your learning beyond your usual A Level curriculum, building valuable skills and knowledge for future study and the workplace. Through our Liberal Studies options, you may explore subjects linked to a university course that interests you or examine a topic linked to your A Level studies.
A Level Mathematics is a good option, regardless of your desired future university study. It develops concepts that you first learnt in (I)GCSE Mathematics and introduces many new ones, to allow you to solve problems with more complexity.
Philosophy is concerned with ideas: ideas about the world, ideas about the self, ideas about others, ideas about right and wrong, and ideas about the beyond. Philosophy pulls these ideas apart and forms them anew.
Physics is a subject for curious minds. It aims to provide a fundamental understanding of our world, from the large scale structure of the universe to the behaviour of sub-atomic particles. Aside from the simple joy of finding things out, physics plays a central role in a wide range of practical applications. Whether you want to develop a Theory of Everything or make your e-scooter more efficient, A Level Physics will help build the skills you need.
It is estimated over 437 million people speak Spanish as a native language, making it the second most spoken language in the world! Being able to understand Spanish not only makes travel abroad easier, it also opens up an exciting range of opportunities. In an increasingly global market, speaking Spanish will help you communicate with international clients, negotiate business deals, and collaborate with experts from across the globe. In addition, language skills are important for professional success in the current business climate, and can help you learn about other cultures and your own!
Extended Project Qualification
Our sixth formers undertake an EPQ, which allows you to work on an independent project, on an academic topic of your choosing, that is relevant to your future plans. Worth half an A Level, the EPQ is highly valued by universities as it offers evidence of your ability to carry out in-depth research and presentation skills, and proof of strong independent study skills.
Discover the benefits of enrolling in our world-class A Level programme and begin your journey to unlimited opportunities.

Co-Curricular Activities
Fostering Excellence with Extensive Opportunities
We proudly support students of all ages in developing their unique interests, whether in class, onstage or on the sports field. Our generous co-curricular offering allows boys to become highly accomplished by exploring a wealth of unique and prestigious learning opportunities.
Our budding athletes achieve excellence owing to our school’s exemplary sports programme, led by top professionals and esteemed guest coaches. Students with a flair for performing access world-class music and drama provision that includes the best tuition from a team of established musicians and the chance to collaborate with theatre experts from London’s West End. Our extensive clubs and societies allow boys to pursue their interests in exciting disciplines, including App Design and Multimedia Creation, which foster the skills for success in the 21st century.
Additional enrichment opportunities are embedded throughout school life, meaning boys are continuously challenged, nurtured and inspired. They emerge confident, multi-skilled graduates, with a strong, resilient mindset for future excellence.
Sports
Our exemplary sports programme is meticulously crafted to promote technical and physical excellence while building a foundation for long-term health and wellbeing.
Students are regularly coached by professionals in their fields, including former English national rugby coach Eddie Jones. With access to the best sports facilities, our boys extend and elevate their sporting abilities. Along with our cutting-edge strength and conditioning suite onsite, students make use of extensive pitches at Ealing Trailfinders, also used by professional rugby and cricket teams.
Sports are compulsory across year groups, and our broad selection caters to all interests, from football, rugby, tennis and cricket to basketball, swimming, yoga and table tennis. Weekly fixtures provide a packed timetable for our numerous sports teams, and external competitions and inter-Trib events allow boys to develop their skills even further, represent their school or Trib, and make lifelong friends and connections.
Music
We encourage all students to develop their artistic abilities. Around 200 boys enjoy one-on-one music lessons, led by highly accomplished professional musicians, who perform regularly with Europe’s top bands and orchestras. Every boy learns to play one brass or string instrument in Year 7 to discover and nurture their unique talents, and establish a basis for future accomplishment.
Our exceptional and active School Choir and many popular ensembles mean that music is a vibrant dimension of Wetherby Senior school life. Concerts and recitals take place termly, allowing students to showcase their outstanding abilities and providing pivotal public performance experience.
Drama
Drama at Wetherby Senior is an exciting experience that cultivates a broad and practical skill set. Exceptional tutelage and prestigious opportunities help learners become skilled performers and experience all aspects of theatre production, both on the stage and behind the scenes.
Our excellent Drama Department produces three large-scale productions every year, in which students participate either onstage or in other areas (e.g., lighting and set design). The Upper School show is our largest production, performed with girls from Francis Holland School, Regent’s Park. Taking place at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art (RADA), the production allows students to experience a professional theatre space and learn from the best in the business by collaborating with costume, set and lighting designers from the West End.
Our central London location ensures easy access to many exciting and innovative productions, and our Drama Department has run trips to see ‘Hamilton’, ‘Othello’, ‘Blood Brothers’, ‘Life of Pi’ and ‘Best of Enemies’ and others.
Clubs and Societies
Our extensive range of clubs and societies helps students to develop a diverse skill set and valuable personal qualities, while also having fun and enjoying new experiences. By exploring new and existing interests, they become highly accomplished, learn teamwork and leadership and build confidence in their abilities. Watch the video to hear from our teachers and pupils, or click on the sections below to find out more.

School Trips
Being based in Marylebone, we provide access to exciting destinations across central London, including parks, theatres, galleries and museums. Our students enjoy plenty of enriching school trips to areas of historical, geographical, literary, religious or scientific interest. We also host talks and workshops with esteemed guest speakers on various social, political and cultural issues.
Community Service
Volunteering and Charity Work
Students in each year group volunteer to support those in the community and across London, whether by helping the elderly use digital devices or assisting learners at local primary schools. They also take part in fundraising activities to support charities chosen by the School Council, having fun while they deepen their knowledge about issues facing the world today.
Duke of Edinburgh Award
The Duke of Edinburgh Award is a popular, challenging and well-respected programme that is achieved by completing a personal programme of activities in numerous sections. It is an excellent opportunity for our young people to enhance their teamwork, organisation and leadership skills.
Leadership roles allow students to contribute positively to our school and broader society while developing important transferable skills. These include Middle School Ambassadors, Trib representatives, School Council positions and, in the Sixth Form, Head Boy, Deputy Head Boy, and prefect positions, along with peer and academic mentors.
Our careers programme starts from the moment boys join (much earlier than most schools) and aims to instil drive and purpose while ensuring each boy fulfils his potential in our increasingly competitive and ever-changing world.
Through our comprehensive approach, which includes mock interviews, skills-based projects, expert talks, internal discussions, personal development, subject linkage and co-curricular activities, our pupils are equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge to make informed career choices. We explore university options and professional life with support from a brilliant range of potential employers, our own exceptional staff and our active alumni network.
Discover more about our broad, enriching co-curricular offering, which cultivates our boys' unique abilities and nurtures resilient and multi-skilled individuals.

pageCache.text:
GCSE
GCSE Programme in Marylebone, London
Students who undertake the General Certificate of Secondary Education (GCSE) at Wetherby Senior benefit from our challenging, nurturing approach that seeks to cultivate their full potential. Our budding scholars choose from extensive GCSE options that empower them to delve further into their selected subjects, achieve excellent outcomes and prepare for A Level success.
Our boys enjoy access to unique and prestigious opportunities to pursue their ambitions and strive for excellence beyond the GCSE years. We regularly partner with industry experts, respected professionals and elite organisations to enrich and elevate boys’ school experiences, foster their talents and provide leading university and career preparation. By getting to know each of our boys individually, our experienced staff produce tailored strategies that support and guide learners on their path to unlimited achievements.
Why Choose Our School to Study GCSEs in London?
Our supportive and stimulating GCSE programme is ideal for getting the best out of each student. Best-in-class academic provision, tailored guidance and exceptional opportunities lead our boys to outstanding GCSE results, cultivate their skills in the classroom and outside, and foster the tools for success in the 21st century.
We provide a structured programme of support for decision-making around GCSE options to ensure that each boy’s selection mirrors his unique interests. To supplement the benefits of our leading academic tuition, boys are assigned a personal university advisor in Year 11 to help craft the perfect pathway to elite universities, including Russell Group and Ivy League schools.
Throughout their GCSE years, boys are empowered to develop their specific skills and talents in exciting disciplines. Wetherby Senior offers an extensive co-curricular programme that caters to every interest and boasts unparalleled tutelage from world-renowned experts in sports, the arts and many other areas.
Our GCSE Programme
Our heads of department have reflected carefully on the GCSE specifications to ensure our boys flourish both in middle school and in the sixth form.
During Years 10 and 11, our meticulously planned GCSE programme allows boys to develop their own academic pathway in a structured framework that promotes excellence and yields plenty of options for the future.
At Wetherby Senior, GCSE course choices are divided into four sections. Students must take: five or six GCSEs in our compulsory curriculum, which includes English Language, English Literature, Mathematics, and the Sciences (Biology, Chemistry, Physics); a modern foreign language (French, German or Spanish); a humanities subject (Classical Civilisation, Geography or History); and a further two options from a choice of language and humanities subjects (Art and Design, Computer Science, Drama, Graphic Communication, Latin, Music and Physical Education).
GCSE Programme in Marylebone, London
Compulsory GCSE Programme
Over two years, you will build a range of critical skills. Through the study of non-fiction passages, you become adept at identifying key information, arriving at original inferences, being able to analyse the effects of language in insightful ways, and able to evaluate information. In addition to the essay writing skills that you obtain from your study of literature, you learn how to produce extended pieces of writing which describe and argue.
In two years, you are taught a range of critical skills. By studying an anthology of 15 poems (from a range of cultures and time periods), a play and a novel, you become adept at understanding the meaning of different texts. You are able to identify relevant information and arrive at original inferences, as well as analyse the effects of language, structure and form in insightful ways. You are also able to respond personally to a text. In addition to consolidating your skills of written accuracy and variety taught in English language lessons, you hone your essay writing, as you learn how to write analytically and in a consistently engaging and academic style. Throughout your course, you get to participate in group work and to present individually to your class. For example, you may present your interpretation of a poem or be asked to perform sections from your set drama text.
During your two years, you develop your knowledge and understanding of mathematical concepts and techniques to become confident problem solvers. Your course is split into four main areas: algebra, number, geometry, and probability and statistics.
All Key Stage 4 pupils at Wetherby Senior are required to study science and have separate biology, chemistry and physics teachers. You either study the Double Award pathway or the Triple Science pathway, both of which impart invaluable scientific skills and a broad knowledge of the three sciences, enabling you to study the sciences at A Level and beyond. Within each science subject, a broad range of topics are covered and both pathways are centred around the idea of scientific investigation: you are taught to be scientifically sceptical and to require high standards of evidence in scientific matters. You become capable of planning practical activities and of choosing apparatus to suit, and you are also skilled in extracting, handling, and displaying data from experiments.
Compulsory GCSE Modern Foreign Language Option
All Key Stage 4 pupils at Wetherby Senior study at least one foreign language, chosen from French, German and Spanish, and sit three separate exams in listening, reading and writing, and speaking.
Compulsory GCSE Humanities Option
Classical Civilisation
Through this course, you develop an awareness of the continuing influence of the classical world, and of similarities and differences between the classical and modern worlds. You acquire, by studying a range of written and visual sources, knowledge and understanding of both Greek and Roman societies, and you develop analytical and evaluative skills. You are also required to formulate informed, personal responses to the ancient source material under study, which enhances your independent learning and critical thinking. You explore a mixture of mythological and historical topics, like the Olympian gods, Hercules’ twelve labours, death and the underworld, and Roman gladiators. As a result of the skills required, you enhance your ability to properly structure an essay and to effectively take notes, which will complement other subjects (e.g., English and History).
Our course is based on a balanced framework of physical and human geography, so allows you to investigate the link between the two themes, and to approach and examine the battles between the manmade and natural worlds. You cover the following topics: natural hazards, tropical rainforests, cold environments, rivers, coasts, urban challenges, the economic world, and resources management. Within these topics, you study key theories through case studies, and develop a range of geographical skills via fieldwork, as well as attending two field trips, in Brighton and in London.
Over two years, you will study International Relations: The Changing International Order 1918-75; Germany 1925-55: The People and State; Power: Monarchy and Democracy in Britain c.1000-2014; The English Reformation c.1520-50; and Castles: Form and Function c.1000-1750.
Further Two GCSE Options
Through GCSE Art and Design, you explore a variety of practical activities and respond in a personal way to different themes and ideas. You experiment with a range of media and materials including drawing, painting, clay, printmaking, photography and digital manipulation, and collage, enabling you to develop confidence in your skills. Over the two years, you visit galleries to investigate the artwork of different artists, and continue to develop your critical thinking in response to a range of art and artists.
Throughout your two years, there is an emphasis on analytical abilities, algorithms and computer logic, coding, and the understanding of technical and legal aspects of high technology. You are also taught a range of key mathematical and technical skills like numeracy, coding and technical terminology.
You explore play texts as directors, actors and designers, and study scripts and perform a play in both acting and written examinations. Our course gives you the chance to write your own plays, act in scripted plays, and attend and review professional plays.
Graphic Communication
You explore a range of practical activities and respond in a personal way to different themes and ideas. You work digitally on a computer and by hand, experimenting with design programmes like Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, and with more traditional manual graphic design techniques like gouache and pen and ink, to produce graphic responses that look professional and satisfy a design brief. You visit galleries to investigate the artwork of different artists, and continue to develop your critical thinking in response to a range of artists and designers.
Our course provides a foundation in both linguistic and cultural competence, enabling you to gain knowledge and understanding of the Roman world through reading and responding to its language and literature. You develop your knowledge of vocabulary, morphology and syntax in order to successfully translate passages of Latin.
Our course encourages you to engage critically and creatively with a range of music and musical contexts, developing an understanding of the place of music in different cultures and contexts, and reflecting on how music is used in the expression of personal and collective identities. Over two years, you are taught a range of critical skills in a variety of interesting ways, including composing, appraising and performing.
Over two years, you are taught a range of content, including biomechanics, physical training, sports psychology and many more. Our course combines the theoretical and practical worlds of PE to provide an in-depth understanding of health and physical activity. You will also complete four sections of Non-Exam Assessment (NEA) which consists of three practical sports and coursework.
To find out more about our excellent GCSE programme and how we unlock boys' full potential, kindly complete an Enquiry Form.
